answer.thought: The hunger is a dull, persistent ache, a physical reminder that my body, unlike my spirit, is not yet free from the particular. I have walked twelve kilometres today, yet I cannot even command a meal from the household. I sit in the white cotton, feeling the coolness of the evening air against the heat of the day, and I wait for the silence to break, or for my own thoughts to fill the room.
